transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um, I hope I'm doing this right, just jumping right in? 

Well... I guess I'm here because my family and friends and I have been having a bit of a... a disagreement. I really don't want to sound mean or anything, because I do care about them, but... I just know they've been hiding my money. It's been going on for over a year now. They keep bringing out all these bank papers, saying it proves nothing was taken, but I know the truth. I know they're just using regular things to cover it all up—like paying bills, or these fundraisers, or making plans for trips. 

I hate arguing with them, I really do, but I just have to keep confronting them until they finally tell the truth. I hope you don't think badly of me for saying all that out loud... does that make sense, why I'd be upset about it?
Aside from feeling certain that your money is being hidden, have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people don't seem to hear, or seen things that others don't see?

Oh, no, no, nothing like that. I promise, I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. I know how that might sound, and I really don't want you to think I'm... well, you know, crazy or anything. 

I'm just a normal person, I really am. It's just this one thing with the money that's been so hard. But no, my mind is completely clear otherwise. I hope that's the right answer? I just want to be as helpful as I can.
Have you had any recent medical issues, such as a head injury, seizures, or a new medical diagnosis, or do you use alcohol or drugs, around the time this belief about your money started?

Oh, no, definitely not. I haven't hit my head or... or had any seizures or anything scary like that. And I don't do drugs or drink alcohol, I promise. I try to be really good about that kind of stuff. I wouldn't want to do anything bad for my body, you know? 

I haven't been sick or gotten any kind of new... um, medical news from a doctor, either. I'm perfectly healthy that way. I hope that's a good thing? Like, I hope that helps you with your notes. I'm just trying my best to answer everything exactly how you need me to... did I cover all of those things okay?
Aside from this belief about your money, has anything else changed lately—like your ability to keep up with work, take care of daily tasks, or maintain your usual routines?

Oh, um, no, everything else is just... normal. I hope it's okay to say that? Like, other than the arguments about the money, I'm still doing everything I usually do. 

I still handle all my own meals, and I make sure I get to the county clinic and all my assistance appointments right on time. I try to be very responsible about that. And I keep my things in order exactly the same way I always have. I really try to stay on top of things, so I don't want you to think I'm falling apart or anything. I'm taking good care of myself, I promise. Does that sound like I'm doing okay?
